name: Lippó (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lippó: a shield of red and blue with a rose, a tower and ears of grain under yellow stars, with yellow and blue mantling and a scroll inscribed 1241 LIPPÓ 1274.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lippó arms with mantling and scroll
